heading: Development cart metafield probe
description: Diagnostic only. This panel does not verify age or approve checkout.
serverVisible: The server marker is visible on this cart.
clientVisible: The client marker is visible on this cart. Function confirmation is still required.
missing: The server marker is not visible on this cart. Open the server-created diagnostic checkout.
unsupported: Cart metafield changes are unavailable in this checkout.
submitting: Waiting for the Shopify write result.
accepted: Shopify accepted the write call. This does not prove that the Function received the value.
rejected: The client write failed or was rejected. This alone does not prove server-only access.
